node.statement: Product right inverse, using nodes 1.2 and 1.3. Approximate associativity gives ||L_{U bold-dot V}-L_U L_V||<=e||U||||V||<=e/(1-e)<1/5. The operator A:=L_U L_V is invertible and ||A^{-1}||<=||L_V^{-1}||||L_U^{-1}||<=49/16, so ||A^{-1}(L_{U bold-dot V}-A)||<49/80<1. The Neumann lemma makes L_{U bold-dot V}=A[I+A^{-1}(L_{U bold-dot V}-A)] invertible. Therefore R_X:=L_{U bold-dot V}^{-1}J satisfies (U bold-dot V) bold-dot R_X=J and is a right inverse of U bold-dot V.
